{{Top|leg}}
The '''StarTripper''' was a type of [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was similar in appearance to SoroSuub's [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]]. One of these [[Starship/Legends|ships]], named [[Bright Sun|''She's a Chancer'']], was present at [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] in [[43 ABY]]. [[Vestara Khai]] took command of it following her escape from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], following a failed [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] of the Jedi. Khai sold it to a mechanic named [[Monarg]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. [[Dyon Stadd]] later made a legal claim to the ship and renamed it ''Bright Sun'' in honor of the newly founded [[Bright Sun Clan]].

==Behind the scenes==
The StarTripper was introduced in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', but ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' refers to the yacht type as "StarTracker" instead.
